{"thought": "依語意層定義，有效訂單為狀態 1/2/3，帳篷為 category='tent'，淨營收 = 商品金額總和（quantity×unit_price_cents/100）扣除對應退款，期間依訂單成立時間（台北時間）歸屬。一次查詢算出毛額、退款與淨額。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "WITH q3 AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')) BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'), gross AS (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents)/100.0 AS gross_twd FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN q3 ON q3.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE p.category='tent'), ref AS (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) AS refund_twd FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN q3 ON q3.order_id=r.order_id WHERE p.category='tent') SELECT gross.gross_twd, ref.refund_twd, gross.gross_twd - ref.refund_twd AS net_twd FROM gross, ref"}}
